Corrected baseline oracle: exact planner/coordinate controls pass; empty input and global CUDA barrier fail.
First integrated planner and IncludeCurrent barrier removal; before explicit intermediate release and Fallback method consolidation.
Fallback before method consolidation; barrier regression fails, coordinate control passes.
Final source, both samplers and registration/budget controls.
Final source, both samplers, CUDA-stream checks, mirror packing and public packing suite.

Broad initial integration; source archived as include_current_integrated_v1.py and test_include_current_copy_v1.py. Before explicit intermediate release and Fallback method consolidation. Final source subsequently covered by current-copy-final CPU/CUDA runs.

data.limits: Seven alternating warm rounds; explicit synchronization around timings. Synthetic planner cases use15/21/32atomtypes and unrelated PBT maximum40/1024. limits: Synthetic indexing workloads are explicitly synthetic, with real copied atom counts15/21/32 and unrelated database maxima40/1024. They do not establish application speedups.

Real workload is IncludeCurrent-only ubiquitin construction at1/16poses. Coordinate/DOF buffers match the parent exactly; independent reconstruction tests compare against pose coordinates at2e-5 absolute tolerance.
Managed CUDA peaks exclude live inputs/caches and all untracked native/process memory. Corrected full construction and DOF-fill peaks are unchanged.
Masked prototype is faster for small ordinary GPU layouts; direct count-based planner was selected for linear space independent of maximum residue size, lower CPU overhead and simpler universal code.

CUDA variable-length repeat_interleave may synchronize its stream to obtain output shape. Only the explicit global barriers are removed; no fully asynchronous or CUDA-graph-capture contract is claimed.
Other OptH and verbose timing barriers remain outside this change. Both sampler classes retain their distinct selection policies and identities.
Broad chemical parameter coverage, old noncanonical score references, AtomWorks release contracts and overall workflow gates remain open.

include-current-prototypes.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=tmol-current-copy
#SBATCH --partition=hpc-low
#SBATCH --gpus=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00
#SBATCH --output=/mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-followup/include-current-prototypes-%j.log
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/home/kdidi/projects/tmol-pr503-review
export PYTHONPATH=.
export TMOL_USE_JIT=1
export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=9.0
export MAX_JOBS=4
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
export SPARSE_AUTO_DENSIFY=1
export TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=/mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-results/extensions-candidate
apptainer exec --nv --bind /mnt:/mnt /mnt/data/kdidi/apptainers/latent-dev-cuda13-26.06-tmol0.1.54.sif python /mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-followup/profile_include_current_candidates.py --device cuda --output /mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-followup/include-current-prototypes-cuda.json
